name: @browser-network/network
description: A WebRTC based direct peer to peer network in the browser.

scripts.clean: shx rm -rf dist build umd; shx mkdir umd
scripts.compile:pack:min: echo 'Minified UMD output is produced by compile:pack'
scripts.build:watch: nodemon -e ts,json -i dist -i build -i umd -x 'npm run compile:ts && npm run compile:pack'
scripts.test: sh -c '(cd ../switchboard && npm run build >/dev/null && PORT=5678 node dist/index.js >/dev/null 2>&1) & switchboard=$!; trap "kill $switchboard 2>/dev/null" EXIT; sleep 1; ./node_modules/.bin/tap --ts --no-timeout --no-coverage test/*.test.ts'
scripts.release: npm run build && np --no-cleanup --no-tests --no-yarn --message="New release! Version: %s"

author: Aaron Sullivan (aasullivan1618@gmail.com)
